en.title: Research
en.description: Research internships at LJK (bilinear map rank) and GAEL (algorithmic pricing).

blocks.title: Research
blocks.lede: Two supervised internships, one in computer algebra and one in industrial economics. Both are published in full, including the parts that did not work.

items.title: Rank of bilinear maps
items.desc: Supervised by Jean-Guillaume Dumas. Cuts 5×5 polynomial multiplication over GF(2) from 25 multiplications to 14.

items.title: AI and strategic pricing
items.desc: Supervised by Alexis Garapin and Olivier Bonroy. A survey, a model, two tournament agents, and a correction to my own analysis.
